spec_match.rationale: Runs the two spec edges: WebIDL enum TypeError on an invalid value, and satisfied-or-default resolution per valid value, plus an unknown-value-safe enum reader per the anti-regression rules.

interactive.rationale: Three independent experiments, each a real constructor call with a verdict region.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises both edges run for real with the no-throw outcome as the honest pre-158 proof; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: The page IS the edge-case page; the invalid-enum probe can genuinely return false and did on this build (no throw, option ignored).

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/<id> plus the exact spec anchor in see-also.

conformance.rationale: cc-invalid-enum-throws-typeerror and the satisfied-or-default assertions in the feature suite mirror exactly these experiments.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified on headless Chromium 141 (predates Chrome 158, feature absent even behind --enable-experimental-web-platform-features) via Playwright 1.56 at desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch, driving every control; screenshots under /tmp/claude-0/agentB/shots/. Invalid-enum run reported 'No exception' (correct for a build that ignores the member); fallback table showed undefined readbacks; reader refused to describe a missing value.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert covers the primary contract and the explicit fallback branch; console output is intentional and prefixed.

design_system.rationale: Only CSS variables from public/styles.css; buttons overriding background also set color; AA pairs (text-charcoal/bg-stone, bg-ivory/text-black, accent-emerald-dark on paper).

accessibility.rationale: Native controls with labels, visible focus (verified first-Tab), caption+scope tables, aria-live polite result regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Both viewports exercised; verdict blocks wrap long tokens without overflow.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the supported path on a real Chrome 158 / Canary build
openQuestions.detail: This environment's Chromium 141 lacks the surface even behind --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, so only the honest-absent branch ran. On Chrome 158 (or Canary with the feature's runtime flag) verify: that { congestionControl: 'bogus' } throws TypeError and that the reader sees only enum values.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Landmarks, native semantics, accessible names, visible focus, and polite live regions for asynchronous state changes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Content sits in main/header/footer landmarks; async results land in aria-live=polite output/status elements; tables carry caption plus th scope=col; first-Tab focus visibility verified in the browser.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsically-sized grid/flex layouts (auto-fit + minmax) so panels reflow without horizontal overflow at narrow widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Control panels use grid-template-columns repeat(auto-fit, minmax()), tables are wrapped in overflow-x containers, and long tokens use overflow-wrap: anywhere; verified no horizontal overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce error/failure outcomes programmatically, not only visually.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Real API errors (name + message) are written into aria-live output regions and colour is never the only signal (text states the outcome).

summary: The probe-can-return-false page: on 141 the bogus value not throwing is itself the evidence, and the page says so.
